summary: Global Cord Blood Corp files Form 6-K reporting the appointment of joint provisional liquidators (JPLs) by the Grand Court of the Cayman Islands under Section 104(2) of the Companies Act. The JPLs' sixteenth report is now available, continuing the court-supervised restructuring process. No specific terms such as price, premium, or timeline are provided. The company is acting as the filer/entity under liquidation. This signals an ongoing restructuring and potential eventual dissolution or reorganization. Watch for further court reports and creditor actions.
